title: CaseForge Mock Court per-answer feedback
description: Deterministic feedback on counsel's answer to the previous Mock Court challenge (B-S4-00b). Every item is tied to the matter record or the counsel-confirmed working set, or says explicitly that nothing was found. It never says an answer is right or wrong and never predicts an outcome.

engagement.description: Heuristic indicator of whether the answer engages the previous challenge's specific terms; shown with its counts.

value.description: Normalised value from the answer: ISO date, digits-only amount, or citation text.

record_ref.description: chronology event_id, evidence_id, contradiction_id, or authority_id.

locator.description: Source pointer (doc_id/page) from the record, when one exists.

x-caseforge.engagement_rule: Content words (>= 4 letters, minus stop/generic words) and normalised dates of the previous challenge; ADDRESSED when >= 40% appear in the answer, PARTIAL when at least one does, NOT_ADDRESSED otherwise. A display heuristic, not a gate or a score.
x-caseforge.language_rule: Messages describe record support only. Prohibited: correct/incorrect, win/lose, chance, likely to succeed, verdict.
